summary: A young man stands on a city sidewalk watching an ice cream truck drive past a grand illuminated gothic church, before the camera tilts up to show the church spire against the evening sky.

people.description: A young man seen from behind wearing a black graphic t-shirt reading 'Wink Wink Nation', black shorts, and white sneakers, holding a paper bag.

moments.action: A young man waits on the sidewalk as an illuminated ice cream truck drives past in front of a lit gothic church
Camera tilts upward past the subject to reveal the ornate gothic cathedral tower and modern skyscraper against the blue twilight sky
good_for: feeling small in a big city
